Well, I came in because, honestly, my husband and the people at the warehouse—they all just keep acting like I'm crazy. Like I'm making things up or something. But I'm not. I know what I see, and I know what's going on. They have been watching my every move at work. Every single thing I do. I mean, I'm just a material mover, right? And my husband, he just rolls his eyes and tells me I need to calm down, that I'm overthinking it, but he doesn't work there. Yeah, actually, they have. It’s not just when I’m running on three hours of sleep and buzzing around the warehouse, you know? So, yeah, even when I was sleeping fine and feeling completely normal, for a solid few weeks there, I was still dealing with all of it.
